footer.value: Post hoc analysis (Tukey’s t -test) showed differences as marked on the chart. All values in the table are average±standard deviation. There was a significant difference between the age of the alcohol-dependent group and the control group ( P =0.0485) with alcoholics being slightly older, a finding driven by the greater age of alcoholic women. There was no significant difference in age in the interaction of group by gender. The alcoholic group had significantly fewer years of education than the control group ( P <0.0001), but again this difference was not significant in the gender by group interaction. There was a significant difference in years of heavy drinking between alcoholics and controls ( P <0.0001) and between alcoholic men and alcoholic women ( P =0.0463) (with women having slightly fewer years of heavy drinking), but there was no significant sex by group interaction in this comparison. Family history positive indicates whether the participants had at least one parent with alcohol dependence.
